question: Estimate the number of cars sold during the festive season (Sept-Nov) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Passenger cars + SUVs? Yes — passenger vehicles.
Festive season window: Sept (Onam, Ganesh Chaturthi) to Nov (Diwali, Dhanteras)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Festive season sales: 42L × 0.42 = ~17.6L ≈ ~18 lakh units in 3 months.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Single biggest day (Dhanteras): ~30,000-40,000 deliveries on a single day.
